email1_A.subject: Sam, your Kickstart program is waiting
email1_A.text:
Hi Sam,

Quick one: you haven't set up JF Coach yet. It takes about 5 minutes and it's what builds your 21-Day Kickstart program, meal guide and targets.

1. Download JF Coach:
   iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/au/app/id6791106148
   Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=au.jamiefitness.coach
2. Open it, tap Log In and enter sam@email.com
3. We'll email you a code. Enter it, choose a password, and you're in.
4. Fill in the short setup form. Your program is built the moment you submit it.

Can't find the code? Check your spam or promotions folder. It comes from support@send.jamiefitness.au.

Please have it done before your first session with Alex on Thursday so you can hit the ground running. Stuck on anything? Just reply to this email.

Jamie
Jamie Fitness
